_source: LCYBL sponsorship packages drafted for the site launch. Prices are placeholders for the board to confirm; edit freely. Reach figures come from the league's own numbers (185 teams / 23 clubs / est. 1954).
_assets: partners[] is empty until the league signs sponsors. Logos added through Admin > Sponsors appear on this page and in the sitewide footer strip. Host logo files under public/lcybl/sponsors/ and reference them by path for the cleanest result.
intro: Put your business in front of thousands of Lancaster County baseball families. LCYBL has served the county since 1954, and today 185 teams across 23 member clubs take the field every season. Every sponsorship goes straight back into the fields, the equipment, and the awards the kids take home.
